en.bdb: Nature of the Love of Sikh with Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan dhekh pata(n)g jiau jotee jot samaavai|

en.bdb: Beholding the flame (of the lamp), as the moth mingles with the flame and

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv mirag jiau anahadh liv laavai|

en.bdb: Deer absorbs its consciousness in the melodious Word, likewise in the river of holy congregation,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat vich meen hoi gurmat sukh paavai|

en.bdb: The Sikh becoming fish and adopting the way of the wisdom of the Guru, enjoys the life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਵਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval chit bhavar hoi sukh rain vihaavai|

en.bdb: By becoming black bee of the lotus feet (of the Lord), the Sikh spends his night ecstatically.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਧਿਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes na visarai baabeehaa dhiaavai|

en.bdb: He never forgets the teaching of the Guru and repeats it as the rainbird does in the rainy season.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਮੁਰੀਦਾਂ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਾ ਸੁਖਾਵੈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: peer mureedhaa(n) pirahaRee dhubidhaa naa sukhaavai ||14||

en.bdb: The love between the Guru and the disciple is such that they do not like the sense of duality.
